CustomField.description: Display the opportunity Stage name when the opportunity is Closed Won or Closed Lost
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ( TEXT( NSP_Opportunity__r.StageName ) = 'Closed Lost' ) , ( TEXT( NSP_Opportunity__r.StageName ) = 'Closed Won' ) ) , TEXT( NSP_Opportunity__r.StageName ) , NULL )
CustomField.label: Opportunity Stage
